metadata.description: Kaldrix and Zentrix for your AI assistant. Kaldrix is the signed, limited permission; Zentrix is the payment desk that checks it again and pays. A person sets the limits; the assistant cannot widen them or approve its own payment. Test service: no real money.

plugins.name: kaldrix
plugins.description: The Kaldrix and Zentrix connector, a skill and a start command: your assistant can pay suppliers inside limits you signed, and a big payment waits for you.
